source.title: WCAT Leader Announcement (December 2023)
source.content:
We are happy to announce that we have a new Team Leader. Zeke Mackay will become the new Leader of the WCA Competition Announcement Team (WCAT). Zeke was already working as a member in the team.

Zeke was selected by the WCA Board and approved in a vote among the current Committee Leaders and Senior Delegates, following Section 4 of our [Motion](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/10.2022.0%20-%20Committees%20and%20Teams.pdf) about WCA Committees and Teams.

We thank Wilson Alvis for the work he has done for the WCAT and extend our support and best wishes to Zeke as he takes on his new responsibilities.

Zeke was the only applicant for the role and his successful candidacy document can be seen [here](https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/18mxz0-wCIu0ZN_rbpRx4vtrC9j8UBKRp).

translation.title: WCA 比赛公示组负责人任命公告（2023 年 12 月）
translation.content:
我们很高兴地宣布，WCA 比赛公示组（WCAT）成员 Zeke Mackay 将出任团队新负责人。

根据[《WCA 委员会与团队动议》](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/10.2022.0%20-%20Committees%20and%20Teams.pdf)第 4 节，WCA 董事会选定了 Zeke，并经现任委员会负责人和高级代表投票批准。

感谢 Wilson Alvis 为 WCAT 所做的工作。我们将支持 Zeke 履行新职责，祝他工作顺利。

Zeke 是此次唯一的申请者，其获选的申请材料可在[这里](https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/18mxz0-wCIu0ZN_rbpRx4vtrC9j8UBKRp)查看。
